purpose: Prioritize verifiable tasks by domain-agnostic operation family and domain-specific scientific context. Benchmarks provide source provenance; concrete workflows remain task designs rather than a ranked category axis.

operations.name: Information retrieval
operations.outcome: Locate reference records or source material and extract specified facts with traceable provenance.
operations.include: Retrieve reference records or extract bounded facts with source provenance.
operations.exclude: Routine input loading; unrestricted literature synthesis; deriving a new scientific result.

operations.name: Data preparation
operations.outcome: Clean, reconcile, normalize or transform inputs and prepare features for analysis.
operations.include: Reconcile records, clean inputs, normalize measurements, transform variables or prepare features as required work.
operations.exclude: Already prepared inputs; incidental file loading or filtering inside another operation.

operations.name: Descriptive analysis
operations.outcome: Compute counts, proportions, distribution summaries or other descriptive measurements.
operations.include: Report observed counts, proportions, distributions, set overlap or descriptive sequence measurements.
operations.exclude: Incidental arithmetic inside another operation; inference beyond the observed summaries.

operations.name: Statistical inference
operations.outcome: Estimate associations or effects, test hypotheses, correct multiple tests or quantify uncertainty.
operations.include: Estimate associations or effects, fit inferential models, test hypotheses or quantify uncertainty; include explicit multiple-testing correction.
operations.exclude: Reading supplied estimates; predictive performance computed only by the grader; claiming causality from an association alone.

operations.name: Predictive modeling
operations.outcome: Fit predictors, generate predictions or assess predictive performance under a declared evaluation policy.
operations.include: Fit or apply a predictor to new observations, or explicitly evaluate predictive performance.
operations.exclude: Model fitting solely to estimate effects; retrieving known labels; selecting a multiple-choice answer; grader-only metric computation.

operations.name: Clustering and dimensionality reduction
operations.outcome: Discover groups or lower-dimensional representations through clustering or dimensionality reduction.
operations.include: Compute clusters, components or embeddings, or assess the structure of a fitted representation.
operations.exclude: Summarizing supplied component statistics; plotting supplied coordinates; a package name such as clusterProfiler without a clustering or dimensionality-reduction requirement.

operations.name: Alignment and matching
operations.outcome: Establish correspondence between ordered sequences, reference profiles or other representations.
operations.include: Align sequences or establish correspondence with reference profiles under explicit matching rules.
operations.exclude: Joining records by exact identifiers; retrieving an existing match.

operations.name: Graph analysis
operations.outcome: Calculate connectivity, paths, network structure or tree properties.
operations.include: Analyze paths, connectivity, topology or tree properties.
operations.exclude: Using a network as background; computing a correlation alone; drawing a graph without analyzing it.

operations.name: Spatial analysis
operations.outcome: Analyze positions, distances, geometry, neighborhoods or spatial dependence.
operations.include: Analyze geometry, positions, neighborhoods or spatial dependence.
operations.exclude: A spatial assay alone; displaying coordinates without spatial analysis.

operations.name: Simulation
operations.outcome: Compute model-generated outcomes under specified conditions and numerical conventions.
operations.include: Run a mathematical or computational system model under specified conditions and analyze its generated outcomes.
operations.exclude: Ordinary predictor inference; incidental random sampling within another method.

operations.name: Optimization
operations.outcome: Find a solution maximizing or minimizing a declared objective under explicit constraints.
operations.include: Submit or evaluate a solution to an explicit objective with constraints.
operations.exclude: An optimizer used internally for routine model fitting without a separate optimization deliverable.

scientific_context.name: Nucleotide sequences
scientific_context.scope: Nucleotide composition, coding regions, sequence annotations and constructs.

scientific_context.name: Genetic variation
scientific_context.scope: Alleles, genotypes, inheritance and population variation.

scientific_context.name: Gene expression
scientific_context.scope: RNA abundance and expression differences, including targeted and transcriptome-wide measurements.

scientific_context.name: DNA methylation
scientific_context.scope: Methylation measurements at sites and regions.

scientific_context.name: Chromatin organization
scientific_context.scope: Chromatin accessibility, occupancy and genomic contacts.

scientific_context.name: Molecular function
scientific_context.scope: Gene essentiality, genetic dependencies, functional annotations and protein activity.

scientific_context.name: Molecular interactions
scientific_context.scope: Protein interactions, binding affinity and ligand–receptor relationships.

scientific_context.name: Small-molecule properties
scientific_context.scope: Chemical structure, solubility, lipophilicity and related compound properties.

scientific_context.name: Disease and treatment response
scientific_context.scope: Clinical phenotypes, disease progression, experimental or clinical treatment effects, drug sensitivity and resistance.

scientific_context.name: Metabolism
scientific_context.scope: Metabolite abundance, biochemical reactions and metabolic flux.

scientific_context.name: Immune repertoires
scientific_context.scope: Receptor sequences, clonotypes and repertoire diversity. Other immune-cell analyses require their measured context.

scientific_context.name: Morphology
scientific_context.scope: Cell, colony and tissue shape, size and structural features. An image alone does not establish this context.

scientific_context.name: Physiology
scientific_context.scope: Functional measurements such as neural signals, breathing and growth.

scientific_context.name: Ecology
scientific_context.scope: Community composition, diversity, population abundance and population dynamics.

analysis_tags.name: Normalization
analysis_tags.outcome: Adjust measurement scale or composition using a declared normalization procedure.
analysis_tags.include: Rescale counts, library sizes or measurement distributions as a required operation.
analysis_tags.exclude: Reading normalized inputs; logarithms alone; normalization internal to a method without a separate required result.

analysis_tags.name: Data transformation
analysis_tags.outcome: Apply a defined mathematical transformation while preserving identities, missingness and units.
analysis_tags.include: Apply an explicitly requested mathematical change of variables.
analysis_tags.exclude: Already transformed inputs; generic format conversion; incidental transformations internal to another skill.

analysis_tags.name: Dimensionality reduction
analysis_tags.outcome: Construct a reduced representation and check its fit, variance or neighborhood properties.
analysis_tags.include: Compute or assess a low-dimensional representation or its variance.
analysis_tags.exclude: Using a supplied embedding; merely drawing coordinates; interpreting a plot without computing an embedding.

analysis_tags.name: Feature selection
analysis_tags.outcome: Select informative features under a declared criterion without leaking evaluation data.

analysis_tags.name: Multiple-testing correction
analysis_tags.outcome: Correct a declared family of hypothesis tests and retain its tested population.
analysis_tags.include: Choose, apply or audit a multiple-testing procedure as an explicit analysis requirement.
analysis_tags.exclude: Counting an already thresholded gene list; an internal default adjustment with no independent requirement.

analysis_tags.name: Sensitivity analysis
analysis_tags.outcome: Repeat an analysis under controlled changes and quantify the resulting differences.

analysis_tags.name: Clustering
analysis_tags.outcome: Partition observations and assess grouping stability, separation or external agreement.

analysis_tags.name: Predictive classification
analysis_tags.outcome: Predict labels or probabilities for withheld observations with a prespecified metric.
analysis_tags.include: Produce discrete labels or class probabilities for new observations.
analysis_tags.exclude: Selecting a multiple-choice answer; retrieving known labels; specialized cell annotation without a separate generic classification task.

analysis_tags.name: Predictive regression
analysis_tags.outcome: Predict continuous outcomes for withheld observations under the required split and leakage policy.
analysis_tags.include: Predict continuous scalar or vector measurements for unseen observations under an explicit split policy.
analysis_tags.exclude: Fitting coefficients for inference; generating molecular geometry; spatial pattern scoring without a supervised prediction requirement.

analysis_tags.name: Model evaluation
analysis_tags.outcome: Compute or compare model fit, predictive performance or calibration under an explicit criterion and sampling policy.
analysis_tags.include: The solver reports or compares fit criteria such as AIC, predictive performance, calibration or generalization.
analysis_tags.exclude: The benchmark grader computes a score on submitted predictions; merely supplying test predictions or out-of-fold predictions.

analysis_tags.name: Data preparation and reconciliation
analysis_tags.outcome: Join, filter, reshape or reconcile scientific records while preserving identity and provenance.
analysis_tags.include: Reconcile identities, missingness, schemas or joins as an explicit analytical deliverable.
analysis_tags.exclude: Routine file loading, incidental filtering, or saving results.

analysis_tags.name: Structured evidence extraction
analysis_tags.outcome: Extract specified facts or measurements with source locations, units and a finite evidence scope.
analysis_tags.include: Extract an explicit fact or measurement with a supporting source location.
analysis_tags.exclude: A citation in background; unconstrained literature synthesis; simple structured database retrieval already covered by database querying.

analysis_tags.name: Computational experiment design
analysis_tags.outcome: Select informative perturbations or queries to distinguish models within a fixed experimental budget.
analysis_tags.include: Choose observations or simulated experiments and submit the resulting design or model.
analysis_tags.exclude: Wet-lab execution; an unrestricted research plan judged for novelty or quality.

analysis_tags.name: Hypothesis testing
analysis_tags.outcome: Test an explicit null hypothesis with the correct sampling unit and report its statistic or significance.

analysis_tags.name: Effect estimation
analysis_tags.outcome: Estimate a contrast, ratio, fold change or model effect under explicit comparison and direction conventions.

analysis_tags.name: Statistical model fitting
analysis_tags.outcome: Fit a specified response model with the required design, covariates and parameter estimation.

analysis_tags.name: Descriptive statistics
analysis_tags.outcome: Calculate requested counts, proportions, distribution summaries or aggregations with explicit denominators.

analysis_tags.name: Association estimation
analysis_tags.outcome: Compute the strength and direction of dependence between matched variables; significance testing is a separate operation.

analysis_tags.name: Record filtering and ranking
analysis_tags.outcome: Select or order records under scientific eligibility, threshold or ranking rules.

analysis_tags.name: Set comparison
analysis_tags.outcome: Compute intersections, differences or membership across declared sets and identifier conventions.

analysis_tags.name: Graph and tree measurement
analysis_tags.outcome: Compute path lengths, branch summaries or other requested graph properties from supplied or reconstructed graphs.

analysis_tags.name: Sequence characterization
analysis_tags.outcome: Calculate sequence composition or site properties under explicit alphabet, ambiguity and alignment conventions.

analysis_tags.name: Sequence alignment
analysis_tags.outcome: Establish correspondence between sequences or reads and a reference under explicit alignment rules.

analysis_tags.name: Reference-based assessment
analysis_tags.outcome: Assess identity or completeness against a specified reference profile and summarize matches.

analysis_tags.name: Reference record retrieval
analysis_tags.outcome: Resolve identities and retrieve source-versioned records or annotations.

analysis_tags.name: Optimization
analysis_tags.outcome: Find an extremum of a declared objective within an explicit feasible domain.

analysis_tags.name: Uncertainty estimation
analysis_tags.outcome: Estimate sampling uncertainty, confidence intervals or related uncertainty summaries.

annotation_policy: Operations and scientific contexts are the two category axes. Count a task once per family or context even when several finer tags map to it.
Retain detailed analytical requirements as analysis_tags. These tags describe methods or finer operations, not a third ranked taxonomy.
Assign work required by the question or its explicit faithful adaptation. Supplied results, background, optional methods and benchmark-grader actions do not earn operation credit.
Preserve input-stage assumptions. Computing differential expression from counts differs from filtering an existing result table; a source-family description alone does not determine all operations.

Visualization is an output property rather than an operation family. Figures qualify only through executable checks of required content, data, labels, scales or geometry; aesthetic or communication quality is not scored.
Use context labels for the biological objects or phenomena actually analyzed. Broad terms such as immunology, microbiology, imaging or systems biology do not establish a narrower context.
Preserve unresolved context mappings for review. Missing or partial annotation is not evidence of zero demand.
Inspect operation–context combinations to plan useful tasks. Raw record counts include repeated studies and overlapping releases and are not generation quotas.
No LLM judge is in scope. A deterministic proxy alone does not establish biological causality, clinical suitability or experimental efficacy.
